mapper.select: SELECT cr.chatroom_no AS chatRoomNo, cr.chatroom_name AS chatRoomName, c.content AS lastMessage, c.send_date AS lastTime FROM CHATROOM cr LEFT JOIN ( SELECT chatroom_no, content, send_date FROM ( SELECT chatroom_no, content, send_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY chatroom_no ORDER BY send_date DESC) as rnum FROM chatting ) sub WHERE sub.rnum = 1 ) c ON c.chatroom_no = cr.chatroom_no WHERE cr.user_no = #{userNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
select chatting_no, content, send_user, send_date, chatroom_no from chatting WHERE CHATROOM_NO = #{chatRoomNo} ORDER BY SEND_DATE ASC
